page.content:
Ole Kirk's son who invented the System of Play and the clutch-power brick.

How Godtfred Kirk Christiansen connects

  • Concept: System of Play — Godtfred Kirk Christiansen defined the System of Play.
  • Item: LEGO brick — Godtfred's 1958 stud-and-tube brick is the modern LEGO brick.

What is Godtfred Kirk Christiansen?

Godtfred Kirk Christiansen pushed the company from loose toys into a compatible system: stud-and-tube bricks that lock, themed sets that share parts, and the idea that every new box extends the last one.

Key threads lead to System of Play and LEGO brick.
